meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in class. Who decided that?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now the basis for it.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing that down. Kids write in one place and paste into another, so it proves nothing about who wrote it. And was Owen asked about any of this before you entered the zero?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
You skipped my question. A seventeen-year-old misquoting Shakespeare is a mistake, not proof of anything.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.
Nothing on his record, in writing, tonight, and that part I'll hold you to. It doesn't make him agree to a rewrite. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in, yes or no?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in our meeting that Owen may complete a supervised rewrite, that its mark will replace the zero, and that nothing will be placed on his record. I still require that commitment in writing, along with a straight answer on whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero was entered. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Fallback position; she took your promise that nothing goes on his record and still wants it in writing tonight, along with an answer on whether Owen was heard before the zero, and she had not yet agreed to the rewrite itself; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was on the table but not closed, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and moved straight on, which took the procedural fight out of the room early.
What cost ground: You left her question about whether Owen was spoken to first unanswered twice and never answered either of her defences, so your evidence never got past her objections.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the whole essay between 11:31 and 11:58 PM the night before it was due, which landed squarely on a late October night like that one; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she called the Hamlet line a misquote, point out that it is not a mangled version of a real line but a line that appears nowhere in the play, ask her to search the scene right then, and answer her question about whether Owen was heard before you move to the rewrite.
